chapter: Leaving New York, jazz styles and religion
title: Seeing broken-down musicians in New York
summary: On reaching New York he saw musicians he idolized looking shabby and determined it would not happen to him.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: After I got to the Big Apple, the ...(?)... in New York, went up there to be able to see what it was all about. And I seen musicians up there I used to read about some (?) and idolize and seen them (?) looking so bad... I said, 'I ain't goin' to let that happen to me.' No. Yeah, they got out so that couldn't...they wasn't even living in dance halls, the actual (?) looked so bad.
These would be musicians down on their luck?
Nowhere to stay. Even their appearance would look bad.
Mmm-hmm. Old clothes, all greasy and nasty and everything. Had some more music(?) up on his own trying to sell to somebody. No, I wasn't going to let that happen to me.
